review:
Bling Blitz Diamond Drop is a gem-and-coin slot published by BGaming using EZreel pay-on-line mechanics. Three diamond chests hover above the reels, and coins, collectors and multipliers fill the screen below.

Three diamond-triggered bonus games are available, and they can combine into one when more than one is activated together. Powerful Collectors gather coin values in view. BGaming rates the game medium-low volatility with a 3,000x maximum and a 96% RTP. The bonus is very frequent, roughly once every 36 spins on average, so expect plenty of feature action. It follows on from the popular Jewel Boom Super Drop.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 36 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
